name: Load the Phase 1 learner experience
description: Verifies the production foundation renders the public IELTS Kenya Center experience and its core navigation without broken content.
expected: The homepage renders the IELTS Kenya Center brand, preparation journey, skills, mock-test, tutor, pricing and resource sections, and the authentication dialog opens.

name: Reject invalid account creation
description: Verifies the account form blocks a password that does not meet the minimum length before sending a signup request.
steps: Enter a full name and valid email
Enter a password shorter than 8 characters
expected: The browser prevents submission and the account is not created.

name: Verify protected profile access is denied anonymously
description: Verifies the protected profile API does not expose learner data without an authenticated session.
steps: Open the application while signed out
Attempt to open the learner profile capability
expected: The protected profile operation requires authentication and no private profile data is displayed.

name: Configure Cloudflare DNS with an invalid setup key
description: Verifies the deployment operations panel rejects an incorrect setup key without exposing or changing Cloudflare credentials.
steps: Open the application at the #ops operations view
expected: A clear invalid setup key error is visible and no DNS configuration is reported as successful.

name: Show a useful authentication error
description: Verifies an unsuccessful sign-in produces a visible error rather than silently failing.
steps: Enter an invalid email address and password
expected: A clear authentication error is visible and the user remains signed out.

name: Create a learner account and show email onboarding
description: Verifies successful registration returns clear onboarding guidance and invokes the configured transactional email service.
steps: Enter a new learner name, email and valid password
expected: The account is created successfully and the user sees a clear message about the welcome email and, when applicable, email verification.
